description: Header file defining the AppNotificationsImplementation class, which manages app notifications, subscriptions, event dispatching, and related utilities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing app notifications and configuration interfaces, managing subscriptions, event dispatching, and notification handling.

classes.name: SubscriberMap
classes.description: Manages subscriber mappings, including adding, removing, event updates, and dispatching notifications.

classes.name: ThunderSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Handles subscription and unsubscription to Thunder module events, and manages notification registration.

classes.name: SubscriberJob
classes.description: Dispatch job for subscribing or unsubscribing to notifications.

classes.name: Emitter
classes.description: Implements the IEmitter interface to emit notifications.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to an app notification with specified context, module, and event.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits an event with payload and app ID.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up notifications for a given connection ID and origin.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided shell.
